Class Chances

java.lang.Object
be.imgn.gaia.core.random.dice.Chances
public final class Chances extends Object
The exact chances of each outcome of a DiceExpression: the value it evaluates to, together with the tags that apply. 
var chances = DiceExpression.parse("(2d20kh1:critical>=20)+5").chances();
chances.of(25);                  // 39/400
chances.atLeast(15);             // 319/400
chances.tagged("critical");      // 39/400
chances.mean();                  // 753/40
chances.where(outcome -> outcome.value() >= 15 && !outcome.tags().contains("critical"));    // 7/10

Chances are counted with whole numbers of any size, and only the fractions that are asked for are reduced. A method that returns fractions throws ArithmeticException if one of them, in lowest terms, has a numerator or a denominator that doesn't fit in an int.

Since:
0.2.0
